explication: Gokapi is a self-hosted file-sharing service. Its principal workflow accepts uploads through the web/API surface, stores file content and metadata, and serves expiring shares for download; administrators configure the service and manage users and shares. The repository also documents file requests, deduplication, encryption, REST automation, S3-compatible storage, OIDC, and UI customization. The sampled excerpts do not show the full server routing or upload implementation, so uncertain internal call links are omitted; documented capabilities are represented without claiming their detailed wiring.
